name: view_m6_sound_levels
description: The Bellfounder's and the Beekeeper's towers sound level with the others (contract-m6.md §5 and §7): each tower form's sound as played is its file's loudest tenth of a second (RMS) plus the gain Game.TOWERS plays it at, and every M6 form's (the toll, the clap, the chime, the bees) sits within 3 dB of the M2 towers' median. The M6 files peak at -1.5 dB, so no gain is above 0.

steps.msg: every M6 tower plays within 3 dB of the M2 towers

steps.assert: Game.TOWERS['toll_tower']['sound'][1] <= 0.0 and Game.TOWERS['great_clapper']['sound'][1] <= 0.0 and Game.TOWERS['deep_chime']['sound'][1] <= 0.0 and Game.TOWERS['great_clay_hive']['sound'][1] <= 0.0
steps.msg: and none is pushed above its file's own level
